name: DIOR-RSVG A/B gate sample (EXP-002)
purpose: Fixed, deterministic text-guided grounding sample for the G5A A/B reproduction gate. Used identically across RSCoVLM-3B, TinyRS-2B, Qwen2-VL-2B.

source_dataset.paper: Zhan et al., 'RSVG: Exploring Data and Models for Visual Grounding on Remote Sensing Data', IEEE TGRS 2023
source_dataset.acquisition: https://github.com/ZhanYang-nwpu/RSVG-pytorch  (Google Drive). NOT downloaded from this host - DIOR images ~20 GB, see EXP-002 blocker log.

selection_policy.ordering: ascending expression id as listed in test.txt
selection_policy.one_expression_per_image_rule: when multiple test expressions share an image, keep the first by expression id; skip the rest until 25 distinct images are collected
selection_policy.bbox_format_reference: Pascal-VOC [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in original pixel coords; model outputs are rescaled to this frame before IoU
selection_policy.malformed_reference_handling: missing/empty bndbox or description -> discard and log MALFORMED_REFERENCE

resolved_note: resolved_ids is populated by evaluation/scripts/exp002_ab_gate.py --resolve once Annotations/ + test.txt are present. Empty here because the dataset is not acquired (artifact-acquisition BLOCKED, see docs/research/EXP-002.md).

metric.definition: fraction of expressions where IoU(pred_box, gt_box) >= 0.5; a query with no parseable box from the model counts as a miss (IoU 0) and also increments failure_rate
metric.threshold_kind: INTERNAL USABILITY THRESHOLD - not an official SIH scoring criterion
